properties.name: Sensitive Group Diversity Report
properties.description: Evaluates preformed groups for distinct sensitive-attribute values against a numeric threshold and returns per-group diversity scores plus classes that fail it.

properties.name: l_diversity_evaluator
properties.description: Measures distinct sensitive-attribute values inside each equivalence class using the column mapping and threshold. It returns an l-diversity report with group-level diversity scores and classes that fail the threshold.
